deploy-bot: Starting deploy to dedicated-us-west cluster
deploy-bot: env=dedicated-us-west-3 service=runtime tag=v2.1.0-beta2 commit=8f3a9c2 change_window=2026-03-20T22:00Z-23:00Z initiator=@anna
deploy-bot: canary_policy=5% traffic 2 nodes duration=5m fallback=pin-to-v2.0.9
anna: Kicking off canary now. tagging release in notes: 'reduce KV cache contention, kernel fallback for int8'.
anna: @ops-sre FYI we'll be watching p50/p95 and kv_cache_miss_rate during canary. will pause on +10% p95 sustained for 2mins.
canary-bot: Canary step 1 completed. 2/2 canary pods healthy. smoke checks: ok. latency_p50=82ms latency_p95=210ms errors=0
nikhil: seeing a small 15% increase in tail latency on one replica: logs show repeated LRU evictions and GC pressure. digging in.
ops-sre: @nikhil thanks. is it correlated with sequence_length spikes or a mem pressure? if mem, we should consider immediate rollback to v2.0.9.
nikhil: it's memory pressure on the new allocator path with int8 kernels - appears on sequences > 2k tokens. reproducing locally.
anna: Can we reduce canary traffic to 1% while we triage? I'd prefer not to roll back if it's contained.
ops-sre: lowering traffic now to 1%. deploy-bot: adjust canary to 1%.
deploy-bot: Updated canary config: traffic=1% duration=10m. will monitor.
canary-bot: After throttle p50=78ms p95=240ms errors=0. single pod still shows GC events ~ every 40s.
nikhil: temp mitigation: disabling allocator path x86-int8-optimized on that node groups via runtime flag. will patch image and redeploy canary if green.
anna: go for patch. please include a config flag so we can A/B test later.
nikhil: patch pushed: image=runtime:v2.1.0-beta2-p1 tag=8f3a9c2-p1. rolling canary update.
canary-bot: Rolling update started on canary pods (2). smoke checks in progress.
canary-bot: smoke checks passed. p50=76ms p95=195ms errors=0. GC events dropped to none observed in last 2m.
ops-sre: looks stable. recommend continuing rollout with 10% traffic for 15m, then full rollout if no regressions.
sarah_pm: calling decision point: proceed to progressive rollout? @anna
anna: proceed. move to 10% for 15m, then 50% for 20m, then 100% if all green. update release notes with mitigation steps.
deploy-bot: Moving to 10% traffic. schedule: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with holds 15m/20m.
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed successfully. final_tag=v2.1.0-beta2-p1 commit=8f3a9c2-p1 finish_ts=1812346278
anna: ✅ Thanks all. follow-up: create a perf regression test for long sequences and add allocator toggle to runtime flags doc.
nikhil: will open PRs for tests + docs. cc: @ops-sre for postmortem notes.
ops-sre: adding brief incident notes to oncall board: minor mem-pressure during canary, mitigated by allocator toggle. no customer impact. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Release artifact: s3://redwood-releases/dedicated/runtime/v2.1.0-beta2-p1/manifest.json
